clips.title: The story
paras: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is an officer of the Stormwind army currently stationed at the Southshore inn in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Deeply unhappy with his frontier posting, he spends most of his time drinking while outsourcing his duties to passing travelers. His primary military assignment is dealing with the encroaching murlocs along the coast, a chore he eagerly delegates in hopes of securing a transfer back south.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle did not choose Southshore. Dispatched far from Stormwind City, the lieutenant finds the damp, contested shores of Hillsbrad a miserable step down from the civilized comforts of the capital. Instead of patrolling the fields or coordinating defenses with his commanding officer, Marshal Redpath, Orinelle has practically taken up permanent residence inside Southshore's inn. His days are spent sulking, drinking, and dreaming of an official transfer order that will return him to the south.
